name: Ikat
desc: Resist-dyed warp-and-weft ikat cloth scrolling up an endless bolt, its diamond and arrow motifs blurred into the signature feathered edges by weft-to-warp mis-registration, a soft silk sheen sweeping across the weave.

energy.doc: sheen amplitude, feathering vigor, scroll punch

scale.doc: motif size (fewer, larger repeats at max)

style.doc: aesthetic: lustrous jewel silk / matte indigo cotton / ombre rainbow warp / near-mono chiaroscuro / tea-stained antique
